report: Findings:  There is a mild - moderate knee effusion. A small collapsed Baker's cyst is noted.  There is incomplete tearing of the posterior root of the medial meniscus with partial extrusion from the joint. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  There is mild - moderate thinning of the medial compartment articular cartilage but no significant underlying bony change. Normal lateral tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage. Normal visualized remaining bone and surrounding soft tissues.  Conclusion: No significant popliteal cyst identified. Mild - moderate medial compartment degeneration. Incomplete tearing of the posterior root of the medial meniscus.

МР находка: Няма данни за ставен излив. Костите, формиращи лявата колянна става са с нормална форма и сигнална характеристика. Изобразява се посттравматичен костномозъчен едем в латералните кондили на фемура и тибията. Артикулиращия хрущял на фемура и тибията е съхранен. Няма данни за ставен излив. МР данни за дегенеративни промени  на медиалния менискус предимно в задния рог. Те се представят като хиперинтензна лезия с хоризонтален ход, недостигаща до артикулиращия хрущял. Няма МР 
данни за пълна руптура на менискуса. Латералният менискус е нормално представен. Кръстни връзки – б.о. Колатералните лигаменти са със запазена цялост. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Патела, хрущял на пателата – б.о. Лигамент на пателата и сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Ретинакулуми – без особености. Заключение: МР данни за постравматичен костномозъчен едем на латералните кондили на фемура и тибията в съчетание с дегенеративни промени в медиалния менискус на лявата колянна става.

COMPARISON:None.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Traumatic fall 5 months prior. Plain films from mild osteoarthritis, assess for ligamentous/meniscal tear left knee.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The medial meniscus shows intrasubstance degeneration in the posterior horn and body, without evidence of underlying tear. The lateral meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

Medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. The fibular collateral ligament is intact. Popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments are intact. Iliotibial band is intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 4 mm, within normal limits. Mild quadriceps insertional tendinosis without tear. Mild proximal patellar tendinosis without tear.

Preserved patellofemoral articular cartilage. There is fissuring of articular cartilage throughout the medial femorotibial compartment, bone weightbearing aspect. Preserved lateral femorotibial articular cartilage.

Small knee joint effusion. Tiny Baker's cyst. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. 

IMPRESSION:
1. Mild quadriceps and patellar tendinosis without tear. No evidence of discrete meniscal, ligament, or tendon tear.
2. Mild to moderate medial femorotibial chondrosis suggesting evolving mild medial compartment osteoarthritis left knee.

In the medial compartment, there are radial tears at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is diffuse low grade chondrosis (less thab 50% thickness cartilage loss) at posterior weightbaring medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. A intact3 cm subchondral bone cyst is present. Osteophytes are identified. 
   
 The lateral compartment, there is large radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is chronic osteochondral injury at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 2.3* 1.3 cm). There is subchondral edema.  
  
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is chronic complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is anterior anterior tibial translation. 
  
 The medial collateral ligamentous complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Some amount of right knee effusion is present. A intact6 cm loose body in the posteromedial recess.The surrounding musculature is normal.  Mild medial tibiofemoral compartmental osteoarthritis of the right knee by evidence of chondrosis, subchondral bone cyst and osteophytes.
